name: web-floating-emoji-avatar-toolbar-pill-on-black
title: White pill toolbar on black with a sparkle icon, three emoji avatars with green online dots and a menu icon
whatItIs: A black canvas with a white capsule holding a gold sparkle, a divider, three round emoji avatars (witch, unicorn, monkey) on green, lilac and yellow with small green online dots, another divider and a grey hamburger icon.
whatItMeans: Playful and compact; a floating pill of avatars feels like a live presence bar.
techniques: Float a white pill on black.
Use emoji avatars in pastel circles.

vocabulary.definition: A pill of controls hovering above content.
A small dot showing someone is online.
An emoji used as a profile picture.
A thin vertical line separating groups.
